description:
Saves a machine learning model as part of a batch job.

The model will be accompanied by a separate STAC Item that implements version 1.4 or later of the [Machine Learning Model (`mlm`) extension](https://github.com/stac-extensions/mlm). The Item must contain all fields that the extension requires: ``mlm:name`` (from the parameter ``name``), ``mlm:architecture``, ``mlm:tasks``, ``mlm:input``, ``mlm:output`` and an asset with the role ``mlm:model`` and an ``mlm:artifact_type``. Most values are derived by the back-end from the model initialization process, the training data and the back-end's software environment. In addition, the back-end must fill the following optional fields whenever their value is known, as ``load_stac_ml()`` needs them to decide whether a model can be run: the bands and ``value_scaling`` of the model input, ``classification:classes`` of the model output (classification only), ``mlm:framework``, ``mlm:framework_version``, ``mlm:hyperparameters``, ``mlm:accelerator``, ``mlm:accelerator_constrained`` and ``file:checksum`` of the model asset.

Set ``return_model`` to ``true`` when ``save_ml_model`` is followed by processes such as ``ml_predict()`` in the same process graph. The default (``false``) returns a boolean success flag, which is appropriate when saving is the job result.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The machine learning model to store.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A distinct name of the model.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Additional parameters to create the file(s).

parameters.name: return_model
parameters.description: If ``true``, return the input model after a successful save so it can be chained (for example with ``ml_predict()``) in the same process graph. If ``false`` (default), return ``true`` on success or ``false`` on failure.

returns.description: If ``return_model`` is ``false`` (default), returns ``true`` on success or ``false`` on failure. If ``return_model`` is ``true``, returns the saved ml-model on success.
